name: Pia♥Carrot e Youkoso!! 4
original_name: Pia♥キャロットへようこそ!!4
source:
It’s the last summer vacation in Taichi’s school life. He got a call from his older sister Akemi inviting him to come to his hometown to play. She works at the Pia Carrot cafe and after being introduced to the manager Sayuri, he ended up helping out at the cafe. This will be an unforgettable summer vacation.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/12/03/december-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是太一学生时代最后一个暑假。姐姐明美打来电话，邀请他回故乡游玩。明美在Pia Carrot咖啡厅工作，经她介绍认识店长小百合后，太一也开始在店里帮忙。这将成为一段令人难忘的暑假。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/12/03/december-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
